sources.title: GitHub - louaibenaissa/Taxi-v3: Using model free RL to train an agent ...
sources.snippet: Overview This repository is a personal project aimed at applying model-free Q-Learning, a Reinforcement Learning (RL) technique, to the Taxi-v3 environment from OpenAI's Gym. The goal is to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application by implementing and experimenting with Q-Learning to solve the Taxi-v3 game.
